checks.message: The site boundary is explicitly provisional, traceable, and never described as an official redline.
All three required key areas are present and explicitly provisional.
Six conceptual land-use polygons partition the submitted boundary without intended gaps or overlaps.
Spatial metrics are derived from the submitted GeoJSON in EPSG:4548; operational metrics are counted from structured scenario/persona files.
The visual pages are offline UTF-8 HTML without remote assets, forms, trackers, or external APIs.
Chinese and English proposal, figure, HTML, A3, and A0 counterparts are generated from the same evidence set.
All required sections contain claim-adjacent source, standard, depth, data, or metric references and link to structured evidence.
All 20 pages across the bilingual A3 booklets and A0 boards were rendered with Poppler and visually inspected for clipping, overlap, missing glyphs, black blocks, page numbering, and margin defects.
